caveats: All 4 test errors involve the Alluvial/Laterite boundary (2 Alluvial->Laterite, 1 Laterite->Alluvial, 1 Alluvial->Black). Alluvial has the weakest recall at 0.906.
Trained on 917 images. Small corpus; the Alluvial/Laterite decision boundary would benefit from more data.
Classifies soil TYPE only. Texture and visible deficiency symptoms, also named in the project documentation, are not modelled.

The Roboflow export applies augmentation before splitting, so some near-duplicate images may span splits. The 96.49% test accuracy is more credible than the previous 5-class model's 100%, but treat it as an upper bound.

metrics.note: Not yet measured for this 5-class checkpoint. The previous metrics (96.49% test accuracy) described a 4-class model and were removed rather than carried over. Re-run notebooks/soil-classification.ipynb's evaluation cells to populate this.

notes: This checkpoint has a 5th class, 'Unlabeled', from the Roboflow export. It is a dataset artifact, not a soil type: the serving layer maps it to 'no confident soil type' rather than reporting it to a farmer.
